subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Taking a bull by the horns

options.text: To decapitate a bull for beef
To make a stupid decision thinking it to be daring
To deal with a difficult situation in a very direct or confident way

solution:
The correct answer is **"To deal with a difficult situation in a very direct or confident way."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Taking a bull by the horns"** is an idiom that means confronting a difficult or challenging situation head-on. (किसी कठिन परिस्थिति से बहुत ही सीधे तरीके से निपटना)

 
 
• **Example:*** I know this project is risky, but we need to **take a bull by the horns**__ and try our best to succeed.*
 
 
 
• The idiom suggests that it is better to face a problem directly rather than avoid it or be passive.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

44:Tb31,
The correct answer is "Active."</stron
